question: What are your greatest strengths?
description: Assesses self-awareness and ability to articulate value.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates whether candidate's strengths match role requirements.
exampleAnswer: My greatest strength is my ability to break down complex problems into manageable parts. For example, when our team faced a performance issue in the authentication module, I systematically profiled the code, identified the bottleneck in the database query layer, and proposed a caching solution that reduced response time by 60%. I also communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Choosing strengths unrelated to the role
evaluationCriteria: Relevance to role, evidence-based, specific examples, professional delivery
followUpQuestions: How do you use this strength in your current role?
Can you give an example where this strength made a difference?
